user.title: Sign in to ČEZ
user.description: Enter your login details for the ČEZ Distribuce portal (dip.cezdistribuce.cz).

select_supply_point.title: Select supply point
select_supply_point.description: Multiple supply points were found. Select the one you want to monitor.

select_hdo_signal.title: Select HDO signal
select_hdo_signal.description: {signal_count} HDO signals were found. Select the one that matches your tariff (you can find it in your contract or invoice).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with ČEZ
reauth_confirm.description: The ČEZ Distribuce portal rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ČEZ
reconfigure.description: Change the credentials for supply point {ean}. The integration also re-detects which portal environment (Household/Business) the supply point belongs to.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid login details. Check your email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to ČEZ API. Please try again.
error.no_supply_points: No supply point associated with this account was found.
error.portal_action_required: After login the ČEZ Distribuce portal requires an action (accepting terms, a contract or selecting an environment). Log in once at dip.cezdistribuce.cz in a browser and try again.
error.supply_point_not_found: The supply point of this integration is not visible under this account in any portal environment.

abort.already_configured: This supply point (EAN) is already configured.
